I read the whole file and the sibling file SmallPerturbation.lean. I also grepped the repo for other uses of the local-stability lemma `eventually_isFredholm_and_index_eq`, `isLocallyConstant_index` and `apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace`.

The file is already layered. `Continuous.isLocallyConstant_index` is the single place where the local index argument is done. The next three theorems reuse it: `ContinuousOn.index_eq_of_isPreconnected` via `domRestrict`, `Continuous.index_eq_of_preconnectedSpace` directly, and `Path.index_eq` through the previous one. `index_eq_of_segment` reuses `Path.index_eq`.

The only other places that use the local-stability lemma are in SmallPerturbation.lean. They are `exists_pos_isFredholm_and_index_eq_of_norm_sub_lt` and `isOpen_setOf_isFredholm_index_eq`. Each has a short, different derivation from the same lemma, so extracting a helper would not remove substantial repetition.

I found no substantial repeated proof machinery in the file or the related sources. The only uncertainty is that I did not search all of Mathlib for similar patterns, because nothing in this file suggested a candidate.
